description: This file is a React component called 'TestDetail' that displays the details of a test, including its test cases. It handles data fetching, mutation (deletion and execution of test cases), and user interface elements such as buttons, links, and dialogs for managing test cases within a test management application.

methods.name: TestDetail
methods.description: React functional component that displays and manages test case details, including fetching, deletion, and execution of test cases, with access control and user interface interactions.
